name: OCSP Request Builder
description: Build an RFC 6960 OCSP request (DER) to query revocation status from a CA responder.

examples.label: Build a request for the test leaf certificate

hints.hash: Only SHA-1 / SHA-256 / SM3 are supported: this is the CertID hash, not the six certificate fingerprint algorithms.
hints.pair: The issuer certificate must really have issued this certificate, otherwise a key mismatch error is returned.
hints.der: The request is binary DER; the result area shows both base64 and hexadecimal.

faq.q: Why is the issuer certificate required?
faq.a: An OCSP CertID combines the issuer hash, the issuer name hash and the serial, so the request cannot be built without the issuer.

faq.q: Can the request be sent to a CA directly?
faq.a: Yes, it is standard DER; `openssl ocsp -reqin` reads it back.

faq.q: Which hash is used by default?
faq.a: SHA-256; SHA-1 is only kept for older responders.
